title: Pollinator Visit Count by Plant
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pollinator:count
| stats sum(visits) as visits by plant pollinator
| sort - visits
description: Counts bee and butterfly visits to different flowers so you learn which plants best support pollinators in your garden.
value: Choosing pollinator-friendly plants is guesswork without data; visit counts show which flowers actually earn their place.
implementation: Log pollinator observations into `index=personal`; review visits by plant and pollinator type.
visualization: Bar chart of pollinator visits by plant.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many bees and butterflies visit each type of flower, so you plant the ones they love most.
